title: Setup: retire Setup → Metadata behind redirects into Studio (datasource kept) and retire Packaged automation's flows half; Studio stops linking into Setup
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P3, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P3 "N-28 Setup → Metadata redirects and Packaged automation retired (D4, D11)"; wait set per schedule review correction 1, plus N-16b. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28562, #28573, #28567, #28566, #28569, #28561

Part of #28236 (P3, child **N-28**) · governs: ADR-0146 D1 (Setup carries no metadata editor or catalog), D4 / Q8, D7 ⛔, D11 "Retire" · lane: `domain:ui` (declared minor surface: the Setup nav entries, their labels, the tombstone and pins in `plugin-security`, `plugin-sharing`, `platform-objects`) · size: L.

**Why it waits.** Each removed Setup route needs a Studio home first: view, dashboard and report (N-17), translation and email template (N-25), flow "new similar" (N-22), permission-set "new similar" (N-20b: Setup's clone button lives on the catalog page this card retires), counts (N-24, with N-04 done, for Q8), the All metadata area (N-26a). N-16b is not a wait: this card removes the Studio → Setup links itself, and an open package-less write with no form behind it is harmless.

**Settled by the record.** Datasource stays in Setup (D1). The action ledger switch stays where it is (D4, last bullet), so Packaged automation retires its flows half and the actions section becomes its own Setup entry. A principal with `setup.access` but no `studio.access` loses the catalog lists (D1: "Setup carries no metadata catalog"; Consequences: an administrator enters Studio behind `manage_metadata`); people-and-organization pages stay in Setup (D7, N-27).

**Settled by M-1 (#28559, ruling comment 6554738464): A.** The on/off switch of positions, permission sets and sharing rules (`catalog-activation.ts`, today on Setup's catalog item page) moves with the item into Studio, on the item page in #28561's All metadata area, the way D4 moved the flow switch; Setup keeps only the people pages (#28241). D7's ⛔ is met once the switch is reachable in Studio, so the four catalog entries and routes retire with the rest.

**Business reason.** Two homes for one item is the defect. Once Studio holds every editor, old Setup links and bookmarks must land in Studio, and Setup must not show a metadata catalog.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`), all in `ui/packages/app-shell/src` unless named.**
- **Routes to redirect** into N-26a's area, keeping the query and the item:
  - the catalog routes under every app segment: `/apps/:app/metadata`, `/_diagnostics`, `/:type`, `/:type/new`, `/:type/:name`, `/:type/:name/history` (`console/AppContent.tsx:1499–1506`; no-app branch :1385–1390);
  - the aliases that chain into them: `component/metadata/directory|resource/*` (:1411–1412, :1540–1541) and, in `ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`, `system/metadata*` (:257–259), `system/objects*` (:255–256), `system/roles|positions|permissions` (:294–296).
- **Kept in Setup:** datasource, which D1 places in Setup. It covers `/apps/setup/metadata/datasource*`, the nav entry `/apps/setup/component/metadata/resource?type=datasource` (`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-plugin.ts:671`) and Home's `sys-datasources` (`layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx:381`). `metadata/package/*` keeps its redirect (:1496).
- **Setup entries into the catalog:**
  - `nav_positions`, `nav_capabilities` and `nav_permission_sets` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:1643–1645`);
  - `nav_declared_sharing_rules` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts:672`);
  - Home `sys-objects` (`UnifiedSidebar.tsx:375`) and the "Manage Objects" card (`console/home/QuickActions.tsx:46`).
- **Packaged automation:** `nav_packaged_automation` (`platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts:63`, pinned by `setup-packaged-automation-nav.test.ts`), ref `automation:packaged` (`services/builtinComponents.tsx:149–154`), export `index.ts:526`. The page mounts `PackagedActionsSection` (`views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx:749`).
- **Studio links into Setup:** `overlayPath` on the landing card (`views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx:50`, :389); the read-only link (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx:862–865`, N-16b's); `packagedAutomationPath` → `auto-empty-open-setup` (`BuilderLanding.tsx:61`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:9796`); the AI review hop `?review=1` (`console/AppContent.tsx:241`).
- **Shared helpers that must survive:** `views/setup/packagedFlows.ts`, `packagedFlowLedger.ts`, `packagedActions.ts` (imported at `FlowLedgerSwitch.tsx:30`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:84–85`, `catalog-activation.ts:50–51`, `permission-set-clone.ts:41`).
- **CI live specs drive the catalog route:** `ui/e2e/live/studio-object-designer.spec.ts:53/64/78` and `studio-editor.spec.ts:56/75` (`test:e2e:live:ci`, run at `.github/workflows/ci.yml:4718`), plus nightly `declared-sharing-rules-reach-13091.spec.ts:19`.

**Wanted.**
1. Every route above redirects to N-26a's area with `?package`, `?scope` and `?review` kept, except the datasource routes. The four `?scope=environment` catalog routes redirect too, once the switch is offered on the item page in #28561's area (M-1 A). Each alias lands in one hop or at most two.
2. `sys-objects` and the "Manage Objects" card leave Home. The four catalog entries leave Setup, and `catalog-activation.ts`'s switch is offered on the item page in Studio (M-1 A, ruling comment 6554738464, cited in the PR). The door and its gate are unchanged. The release note says an administrator with `setup.access` but no `studio.access` switches these items in Studio. Retired translation keys get a tombstone row (`setup-nav-dead-key-tombstone.test.ts`).
3. Packaged automation's flows half retires: the nav entry, the ref, the export and the page. The actions section stays as its own Setup entry ("Packaged actions"), because D4 keeps the action switch where it is and no card of this epic moves it.
4. Studio stops linking into Setup. The landing's overlay link goes, the `~org` empty state is reworded with no link out, and the review hop goes straight to Studio.
5. The three CI live specs and the nightly one are re-pointed to the Studio door in this PR.

**Tests.** A redirect table test over every route and alias above, including datasource staying put. The nav pins are inverted: absent entries, the actions entry present. The tombstone is extended. There are no Studio links into `/apps/setup/metadata` (a source grep pin). The live allowlist is green.

**Release safety.** Every editor and every "new similar" has a Studio home (Blocked-by). Whether or not N-16b has landed, nothing links to the retired routes, and a package-less write left open has no form behind it. A principal with `setup.access` but no `studio.access` loses the catalog lists (D1); assignments stay on Setup pages (N-27). The release notes say so.

**Not here.** The area (N-26a), marks (N-26b), QA items and the journey e2e (N-29), the action ledger switch's future home (out of epic, #27842).

**Dedupe.** Searched `setup metadata redirect studio`, `"packaged automation" retire`: only #28236, #28413 and QA runs.

Links back: #28236, #28241, #27842, ADR-0146 D1, D4, D7, D11, Q8, ADR-0126 §7.4.
